title: 36 Hours in Aspen, Colorado
abstract: A winter wonderland that combines the wilderness experience with skiing, snowboarding, shopping and dining, that can be enjoyed without breaking the bank.

title: 36 Hours in Houston
abstract: America’s youngest city offers a potpourri pot of cuisines, quirky shops and art with both global and local reach.

title: 36 Hours in Pasadena, California
abstract: Beyond its well-known cultural institutions, this sunny city offers distinctive architecture, a venerable playhouse and beloved shops.

title: 36 Hours in Palm Springs, California
abstract: The city's midcentury modern architecture, which effortlessly blends desert and design, is all the rage.
